text:
jamie: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — I'd like to lock owners + timelines for customer-facing comms. Main items: statuspage wording, external digest format, and RCA sharing policy. @maria can you own statuspage wording?

maria: Yep. I drafted a tighter statuspage blurb. Suggestion:

```
Incident: Degraded API performance
Impact: Some hosted API requests experienced increased latency (10-30s) for ~45m
Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback pool; full recovery at 20:12 UTC
Next steps: Root cause investigation and permanent fix in progress; will share RCA and timeline within 72h
```

Is that too detailed? :thinking_face:

alex: That reads fine. Can we add a link to customer-facing docs for troubleshooting? Also I can push a template change to statuspage by EOD tomorrow (ETA 2024-06-12).

sarah: On RCA sharing: we need to ensure we follow consent + legal. Current policy is internal by default; share externally only after redaction + customer consent. Link: https://redwood.internal/policy/rca-sharing (cc @maria)

maria: ok I'll remove internal-only details and add a 'what we know/what we're working on' section. Will update the doc and ping here when done.

jamie: Action tracker updates:
- COMM-342 (statuspage template) — owner: alex — due: 2024-06-12
- COMM-343 (external digest format) — owner: maria — due: 2024-06-14
- COMM-344 (RCA sharing checklist) — owner: sarah/legal — due: 2024-06-15

incidents-bot: New actions created: COMM-342, COMM-343, COMM-344 — assign and comment to update status.

alex: Created COMM-342 and linked PR: https://git.redwood.com/statuspage/templates/pull/88 I'll include the sample blurb.

maria: Draft pushed to https://docs.redwood.com/comm/digest-draft.md — needs review.

jamie: Thanks. Plan: close loop in Friday ops sync; if any blocking items escalate to Triage channel. :thumbsup:
